abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain the abstract concept clearly.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表清楚解釋這個抽象概念。

accompany.en: A short explanation will accompany each chart in the final report.
accompany.zh: 最後報告中的每張圖表都會附上一段簡短說明。

accumulate.en: Small errors can accumulate if the data are not checked regularly.
accumulate.zh: 如果沒有定期檢查資料，小錯誤可能會逐漸累積。

acknowledge.en: The report should acknowledge the limits of the experiment.
acknowledge.zh: 這份報告應該承認實驗的限制。

adjacent.en: The science room is adjacent to the school library.
adjacent.zh: 自然科教室就在學校圖書館旁邊。

advocate.en: Many students advocate a later starting time for school.
advocate.zh: 許多學生主張學校應該晚一點開始上課。

aggregate.en: The chart shows the aggregate results from all five classes.
aggregate.zh: 這張圖表顯示五個班級的總合結果。

ambiguous.en: The question was ambiguous, so several students interpreted it differently.
ambiguous.zh: 這題意思不夠明確，所以幾位學生有不同解讀。

anticipate.en: We anticipate more visitors during the school festival this year.
anticipate.zh: 我們預期今年校慶會有更多訪客。

arbitrary.en: The groups were not chosen by an arbitrary method.
arbitrary.zh: 這些小組不是用任意方式分配的。

assemble.en: Students assemble the model carefully before testing its strength.
assemble.zh: 學生先仔細組裝模型，再測試它的強度。

attain.en: Regular practice can help students attain higher reading accuracy.
attain.zh: 規律練習可以幫助學生達到更高的閱讀正確率。

compatible.en: The new software is compatible with most school computers.
compatible.zh: 這套新軟體和大多數學校電腦相容。

complement.en: The graphs complement the written explanation in the report.
complement.zh: 這些圖表可以補充報告中的文字說明。

comprehensive.en: The final review provides a comprehensive summary of the entire unit.
comprehensive.zh: 最後複習提供了整個單元的完整總結。

concurrent.en: The school avoided scheduling concurrent exams for major subjects.
concurrent.zh: 學校避免把主要科目的考試排在同一時間。

confine.en: Please confine your answer to the information given in the passage.
confine.zh: 請把答案限制在文章提供的資訊範圍內。

consecutive.en: The team won three consecutive matches during the tournament.
consecutive.zh: 這支隊伍在比賽中連續贏了三場。

constitute.en: These three sections constitute the main part of the report.
constitute.zh: 這三個部分構成報告的主要內容。

contemporary.en: The course compares classical literature with contemporary writing.
contemporary.zh: 這門課比較古典文學與當代寫作。

controversial.en: The class discussed the controversial topic from several different viewpoints.
controversial.zh: 全班從幾個不同觀點討論這個具爭議的議題。

conventional.en: The new design uses less energy than a conventional system.
conventional.zh: 這個新設計比傳統系統使用更少能源。

cumulative.en: The final grade includes a cumulative score from several assignments.
cumulative.zh: 期末成績包含數次作業累積而成的分數。

deduce.en: Students can deduce the answer by comparing the two graphs.
deduce.zh: 學生可以藉由比較兩張圖表推導出答案。

denote.en: The red line will denote the highest value on the graph.
denote.zh: 紅線將表示圖表上的最高數值。

discrete.en: The survey divides the responses into several discrete categories.
discrete.zh: 這份調查把回答分成幾個彼此分開的類別。

distribute.en: The teacher will distribute the worksheets before the activity begins.
distribute.zh: 活動開始前老師會發下學習單。

duration.en: The duration of the experiment was exactly thirty minutes.
duration.zh: 這項實驗的持續時間正好是三十分鐘。

dynamic.en: The classroom became more dynamic after students began working in groups.
dynamic.zh: 學生開始分組活動後，課堂變得更有活力。

enforce.en: The school must enforce the same safety rules for every class.
enforce.zh: 學校必須對每個班級一致執行相同的安全規定。

entity.en: Each company is treated as a separate entity in the database.
entity.zh: 資料庫把每家公司視為獨立個體。

equilibrium.en: The system eventually reached equilibrium after the temperature stopped changing.
equilibrium.zh: 溫度停止變化後，系統最後達到平衡。

evaluate.en: Students evaluate each source before using it in their reports.
evaluate.zh: 學生在報告中使用資料前會先評估每個來源。

exceed.en: The final cost should not exceed the amount in the budget.
exceed.zh: 最後成本不應超過預算中的金額。

exhibit.en: The sample may exhibit different properties at higher temperatures.
exhibit.zh: 這個樣本在較高溫度下可能呈現不同特性。

finite.en: The project has a finite amount of time and money available.
finite.zh: 這項專題可使用的時間與資金都是有限的。

formulate.en: The group will formulate a new hypothesis after reviewing the data.
formulate.zh: 小組檢視資料後會提出新的假設。

hierarchy.en: The diagram shows the hierarchy of roles within the organization.
hierarchy.zh: 這張圖顯示組織內部職務的階層關係。

implicit.en: The passage contains an implicit message about personal responsibility.
implicit.zh: 這篇文章包含一個關於個人責任的隱含訊息。

inhibit.en: Lack of sleep can inhibit concentration during difficult tasks.
inhibit.zh: 睡眠不足可能妨礙人在困難任務中的專注力。

intervene.en: The teacher may intervene if the discussion becomes too confusing.
intervene.zh: 如果討論變得太混亂，老師可能會介入。

isolate.en: Researchers isolate one variable to study its effect more clearly.
isolate.zh: 研究人員會隔離單一變因，以更清楚研究它的影響。

likewise.en: The first group improved after practice, and the second group did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組練習後有所進步，第二組也同樣進步。

magnitude.en: The graph shows the magnitude of change in each region.
magnitude.zh: 這張圖顯示各地區變化的幅度。

mediate.en: The counselor helped mediate the disagreement between the two groups.
mediate.zh: 輔導老師協助調解兩組之間的爭議。

minimal.en: The final design uses a minimal amount of material.
minimal.zh: 最後的設計使用最少量的材料。

mutual.en: The agreement was based on mutual trust between both sides.
mutual.zh: 這項協議建立在雙方彼此信任的基礎上。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding the delay, the team completed the project on time.
notwithstanding.zh: 儘管有所延誤，團隊仍準時完成專題。

offset.en: The energy savings may offset the higher initial cost.
offset.zh: 節省的能源費用可能抵銷較高的初期成本。

paradigm.en: The invention created a new paradigm for classroom learning.
paradigm.zh: 這項發明為課堂學習建立了新的模式。

parallel.en: The two experiments followed parallel procedures with different materials.
parallel.zh: 這兩項實驗使用不同材料，但採用相似的平行流程。

precede.en: A short introduction will precede the main presentation.
precede.zh: 主要簡報開始前會先有一段簡短介紹。

predominant.en: Blue was the predominant color in the final design.
predominant.zh: 藍色是最後設計中最主要的顏色。

random.en: The researcher selected a random sample from the student population.
random.zh: 研究人員從學生群體中隨機選取樣本。

refine.en: The team will refine the model after reviewing the test results.
refine.zh: 團隊檢視測試結果後會改良模型。

relatively.en: The second method is relatively simple compared with the first.
relatively.zh: 和第一種方法相比，第二種方法相對簡單。

restore.en: Workers plan to restore the old building without changing its appearance.
restore.zh: 工人計畫修復老建築，同時不改變它的外觀。

simulate.en: The computer program can simulate changes in weather conditions.
simulate.zh: 這套電腦程式可以模擬天氣條件的變化。

successive.en: Each successive test produced a slightly more accurate result.
successive.zh: 每次接續進行的測試都產生稍微更準確的結果。

summarize.en: Please summarize the main argument in two or three sentences.
summarize.zh: 請用兩到三句話總結主要論點。

supplement.en: The teacher provided extra readings to supplement the textbook.
supplement.zh: 老師提供額外閱讀資料來補充課本內容。

suppress.en: Noise-canceling materials can suppress unwanted sound in the room.
suppress.zh: 吸音材料可以抑制室內不需要的聲音。

trace.en: Students trace the development of the idea across the passage.
trace.zh: 學生追蹤這個觀點在文章中的發展。

uniform.en: The measurements remained uniform across all four samples.
uniform.zh: 四個樣本的測量結果都保持一致。

unify.en: A clear theme can unify the different sections of an essay.
unify.zh: 清楚的主題可以把文章不同部分統整起來。

validity.en: The researcher questioned the validity of the original survey results.
validity.zh: 研究人員質疑原始調查結果的有效性。

whereby.en: The school introduced a system whereby students can borrow tablets.
whereby.zh: 學校建立一套讓學生可以借用平板的制度。
